movers24h.vulnerabilityName: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: RoundCube Webmail Cross-site Scripting Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the animate tag in an SVG document.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox contains a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability that allows unintended disclosure of system files.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: IBM Aspera Faspex Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Sangoma Switchvox SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Sangoma Switchvox contains a SQL injection vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements against the backend PostgreSQL database using a single crafted request, including database operations and remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that allows for authentication bypass.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox Hard Coded Cryptographic Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Gladinet CentreStack and TrioFox contain a hardcoded cryptographic keys vulnerability for their implementation of the AES cryptoscheme. This vulnerability degrades security for public exposed endpoints that may make use of it and may offer arbitrary local file inclusion when provided a specially crafted request without authentication.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiWeb OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiWeb contains an OS command Injection vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code on the underlying system via crafted HTTP requests or CLI commands.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Samsung Mobile Devices Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Samsung mobile devices contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libimagecodec.quram.so. This vulnerability could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System Driver contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow a local, privileged attacker to bypass certain security mechanisms.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Sudo Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Sudo contains an inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow local attacker to leverage sudo’s -R (--chroot) option to run arbitrary commands as root, even if they are not listed in the sudoers file.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Apex One OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One Management Console (on-premise) contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a pre-authenticated remote attacker to upload malicious code and execute commands on affected installations.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Excel Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Office Excel contains a remote code execution vulnerability that can be exploited when a specially crafted Excel file is opened. This malicious file could be delivered as an email attachment or hosted on a malicious website. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability by creating a specially crafted Excel file, which, when opened, allowing an attacker to execute remote code on the affected system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to gain super-admin privileges via crafted CSF proxy requests.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: RoundCube Webmail Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the handling of SVG animate attributes that allows a remote attacker to run malicious JavaScript code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Roundcube Webmail Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Roundcube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to manipulate data via a malicious XML attachment.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting Service Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting Service contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows a local attacker with user permissions to gain SYSTEM privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft DWM Core Library Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft DWM Core Library contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SmartScreen Prompt Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft SmartScreen Prompt contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass the Mark of the Web (MotW) feature. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-38831 and CVE-2024-21412 to execute a malicious file.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for a denial-of-service when configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or AAA virtual server.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS ImageIO Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in ImageIO when processing a maliciously crafted image, which may lead to code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2023-41061.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that enables an authenticated administrator to perform malicious file writes to the EPMM server. This vulnerability can be used in conjunction with CVE-2023-35078 to bypass authentication and ACLs restrictions (if applicable).

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Unspecified Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The GDrv low-level driver in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II exposes ring0 memcpy-like functionality that could allow a local attacker to take complete control of the affected system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Linux kernel fails to check all 64 bits of attr.config passed by user space, resulting to out-of-bounds access of the perf_swevent_enabled array in sw_perf_event_destroy(). Explotation allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiADC Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiADC contain an improper access control vulnerability that allows attackers to obtain the LDAP server login credentials configured in FortiGate by pointing a LDAP server connectivity test request to a rogue LDAP server.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Runtime Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Runtime contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Object Record Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Office contains an object record corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted Excel file with a malformed record object.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to gain privileges via a crafted web site.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft IME Japanese Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Input Method Editor (IME) Japanese is a keyboard with Japanese characters that can be enabled on Windows systems as it is included by default (with the default set as disabled). IME Japanese contains an unspecified vulnerability when IMJPDCT.EXE (IME for Japanese) is installed which allows attackers to bypass a sandbox and perform privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Update Notification Manager Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Update Notification Manager contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows AppX Deployment Extensions Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows AppX Deployment Extensions improperly performs privilege management, resulting in access to system files.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows CLFS Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Network-Attached Storage (NAS) Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: QNAP NAS devices contain a command injection vulnerability which could allow attackers to perform remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft DirectX Graphics Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists when the DirectX Graphics Kernel (DXGKRNL) driver improperly handles objects in memory.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft DirectX Graphics Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists when the DirectX Graphics Kernel (DXGKRNL) driver improperly handles objects in memory.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Word Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Word allows attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via crafted RTF data.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Scripting Engine Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the scripting engine handles objects in memory in Internet Explorer.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting Manager Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows Error Reporting manager improperly handles hard links. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could overwrite a targeted file leading to an elevated status.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Task Scheduler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in the way the Task Scheduler Service validates certain file operations.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows AppX Deployment Service (AppXSVC) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppXSVC improperly handles hard links. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run processes in an elevated context.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which could allow an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by supplying a crafted serialized PHP object in the CacheWarmer cookie.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that allows for authentication bypass.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SolarWinds Serv-U Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Oracle WebLogic Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Oracle WebLogic Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability within Apache Commons, which can allow for for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: RoundCube Webmail Cross-site Scripting Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the animate tag in an SVG document.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox contains a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability that allows unintended disclosure of system files.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium Animation Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium Animation contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache Kylin OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache Kylin contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could permit an attacker to perform remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Untrusted Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Agere Modem Driver contains an untrusted pointer dereference vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could gain administrator privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SAP NetWeaver Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a directory traversal vulnerability via a ..\ (dot dot backslash) in the fileName parameter to CrashFileDownloadServlet. This allows remote attackers to read files.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Nagios XI OS Command Injection
movers7d.shortDescription: Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Trimble Cityworks Deserialization Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Trimble Cityworks contains a deserialization vulnerability. This could allow an authenticated user to perform a remote code execution attack against a customer's Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS) web server.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability that can allow a malicious app to bypass signature validation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS Software SNMP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS 1 contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code on an affected system or cause an affected system to reload. An attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities by sending a crafted SNMP packet to an affected system via IPv4 or IPv6.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Oracle VirtualBox Insufficient Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: An input validation vulnerability exists in the VBoxDrv.sys driver of Sun xVM VirtualBox which allows attackers to locally execute arbitrary code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Storage Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and Safari WebKit Storage contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS WebKit Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS WebKit contains a buffer-overflow vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS WebKit contain a memory corruption vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Integer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and Safari WebKit contain an integer overflow vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) Unspecified Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) kernel driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that may allow a non-privileged user to gain write access to read-only memory, gain root privilege, corrupt memory, and modify the memory of other processes.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Incorrect Implementation Vulnerabililty
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an inappropriate implementation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium WebGL Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium WebGL contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer contain a memory corruption vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code in the context of the current user.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability when handling objects in memory that allows attackers to escalate privileges and execute code in kernel mode.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.product: Apex One, OfficeScan and Worry-Free Business Security Agents
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Multiple Products Content Validation Escape Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security agents contain a content validation escape vulnerability that could allow an attacker to manipulate certain agent client components.

movers7d.product: Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to upload files.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

movers7d.product: Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services Insufficient Granularity of Access Control Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services contains an insufficient granularity of access control vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Apex One (On-Premise) Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One (on-premise) contains a directory traversal vulnerability that could allow a pre-authenticated local attacker to modify a key table on the server to inject malicious code to deploy to agents on affected installations.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability due to improper file handling on the API interface of an affected system. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by uploading a malicious file on the local file system. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to overwrite arbitrary files on the affected system and gain vmanage user privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Improper Locking Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple watchOS, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, and tvOS contain an improper locking vulnerability that could allow a malicious application to cause unexpected changes in memory shared between processes.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Classic UI where attackers could abuse Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) @import directives in email HTML.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS and iPadOS Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS and iPadOS contain a use-after-free vulnerability. An app may be able to execute arbitrary code with kernel privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a memory corruption vulnerability while using alignments for memory allocation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow an attacker with memory write the capability to execute arbitrary code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Word Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Office Word contains a reliance on untrusted inputs in a security decision vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Prettier eslint-config-prettier Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Prettier eslint-config-prettier contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability. Installing an affected package executes an install.js file that launches the node-gyp.dll malware on Windows.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability.

newest.vulnerabilityName: UnrealIRCd Improper Neutralization of Delimiters Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd contains an improper neutralization of delimiters vulnerability that allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Firewall, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Scalable Platforms, Security Gateway, and Security Management Server contain an incorrect permissions assignment for critical resources vulnerability when the Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco BroadWorks Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.

newest.vulnerabilityName: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.

newest.vulnerabilityName: OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

newest.vulnerabilityName: IBM Aspera Faspex Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.

newest.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

newest.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

newest.product: Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

newest.vulnerabilityName: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.
